name: A-4E Early (M)
description: The A-4E Early (A4D-5) was part of the revision that improved the previous Skyhawk variants. It featured the J52-P-6A engine, which had better fuel consumption while also providing much more thrust. Other improvements included more hardpoints and new computers for navigation, bomb dropping, and more. The A-4E also marked the beginning of the new naming system for the Skyhawk. The "Early" versions of the A-4E lacked the iconic "humpback" behind the cockpit, which housed additional electronics. They also lacked the improved J52-P-8 engine. During the Yom Kippur War, Israel was losing Skyhawks at an astonishing rate, which led to more than 25 A-4E Skyhawks being transferred over. The Israeli A-4E Early (M) Skyhawk was introduced in Update "Winged Lions" and can be seen as a weaker version of the premium A-4E . Most importantly, the A-4E Early lacks the J52-P-8A engine found in the A-4E, which provides an 8% increase in thrust. Other than that, it is very similar to the regular A-4E. The A-4E Early comes armed with the standard two 30 mm DEFA cannons mounted in the chin as well as two AIM-9B Sidewinders. The Sidewinders are quite useful for forcing opponents to lose energy and speed, and for picking off slower targets. The A-4E Early also has 60 countermeasures, allowing for 30 drops. These are particularly useful against Sea Vixens, and in uptiers where missiles like the AIM-9G and R-60 are prevalent.
